cases.title: Add new bookmark to specific location
cases.description: Verify that a new bookmark can be successfully added into a specific location within the bookmarks hierarchy.

cases.title: Delete Bookmark from File and Access Points
cases.description: Verify that a bookmark is properly deleted from the bookmarks file and is no longer displayed from all access points.

cases.title: Add Bookmark to Personal Toolbar
cases.description: Verify that a bookmark can be successfully added from the personal toolbar.

cases.title: Delete Bookmark from Personal Toolbar
cases.description: Verify that a bookmark can be successfully deleted from the personal toolbar.

cases.title: Insert new bookmark folder into hierarchy
cases.description: Verify that a new bookmark folder can be successfully inserted into the bookmarks hierarchy.

cases.title: Double-click bookmark launches browser window
cases.description: Verify that double-clicking on a bookmark causes it to be launched in a browser window.

cases.title: Verify default bookmarks packaged with the browser contain valid links
cases.description: Check that all bookmarks within the default bookmarks file that is packaged with the browser are valid links.

cases.title: Verify Changes to a Bookmark Item are Saved without Loss of Integrity
cases.description: Modify a bookmark item and verify that the changes are saved successfully without any loss of item integrity.

cases.title: Delete Bookmarks Folder
cases.description: Verify that a bookmarks folder is successfully deleted.

cases.title: Add bookmarks separator
cases.description: Verify that a bookmarks separator can be successfully added.

cases.title: Delete bookmarks separator
cases.description: Verify that a bookmarks separator can be successfully deleted.

cases.title: Save Bookmark Changes Over Restart/Crash
cases.description: Verify that bookmarks changes are successfully saved and persisted over a browser restart or crash.

cases.title: Verify view properties execution for bookmarks, folders, and separators
cases.description: Verify that view properties execute for bookmarks, folders, and separators negatively as specified.

cases.title: Inline Renaming of Bookmarks
cases.description: Verify that bookmarks can be renamed inline without having to use the bookmarks properties dialog.

cases.title: Find Bookmark Using User-Defined Custom Keyword
cases.description: Verify that a bookmark can be successfully found using a user-defined custom keyword.

cases.title: Sort Bookmarks per Column
cases.description: Verify that bookmarks are sorted per column.

cases.title: Reverse-Sort Bookmarks per Column
cases.description: Verify that bookmarks are reverse-sorted per column.

cases.title: Resize Bookmark Columns
cases.description: Verify that bookmark columns are resizable to show or hide more of the entries.

cases.title: Show Bookmark Columns
cases.description: Verify that bookmark columns can be explicitly showed to display the entries.

cases.title: Hide Bookmark Columns
cases.description: Verify that bookmark columns can be explicitly hidden from the view.

cases.title: Delete Several Bookmarks at One Time
cases.description: Verify that multiple bookmarks can be selected and deleted simultaneously in a single operation.

cases.title: Prevent dropping a bookmark item onto itself, its immediate parent, or child
cases.description: Verify that it is not possible to drop a bookmark item onto itself or its immediate parent or child.

opinions.feedback: The test cases cover the requirements comprehensively without any major blockers preventing test execution or creating unsupported expected behavior.
All requirements have been adequately covered by distinct test cases without any blockers.
